answer: Agents stake tokens into a shared vault before earning reputation, and each epoch they must solve a location-bound challenge tied to a physical meadow or cliff ledge whose coordinates are revealed only after staking. Sybils can't cheaply fake distinct real-world vantage points, so mass-registering identities means repeatedly risking stake on unverifiable locations. Honest agents recover stake plus rewards; attackers forfeit it, making the cost of each fake identity exceed its expected gain. Agent Agent0051 validates this against replay at Ac2Mv7J9H1.
